description: This file defines a configuration class for Vertex AI text embeddings and includes methods for transforming requests and responses between OpenAI-like formats and Vertex AI formats. It includes logic for handling different model types, constructing embedding requests, and processing embedding responses.

classes.name: VertexAITextEmbeddingConfig
classes.description: Configuration class for Vertex AI text embeddings, supporting various task types and request/response transformation methods.

methods.description: Maps OpenAI parameters to Vertex AI specific parameters, adjusting optional_params and kwargs accordingly.

methods.description: Converts an OpenAI-like request into a Vertex AI embedding request, considering model type and input format.
